subject: Final POC Readout & Exec Decision - ZenWell
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Wu <james.wu@zenwell.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@zenwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: POC next steps & success criteria - ZenWell

Hi James / Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciate the context on ZenWell's priority workflows. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the POC: 

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks):
- Ingest ~100K anonymized messages for intent/routing test
- Real-time generation: end-to-end latency under 350ms p90 for 128-token responses
- Precision target: >= 90% on intent classification labels vs. your gold set
- Stability: zero system-level errors during 48h continuous load test

Success criteria (attached as spreadsheet): zenwell_poc_success_criteria.xlsx

Suggested timeline:
- Prep & SSO setup: Dec 2–7
- POC execution: Dec 8–19
- Final readout & exec decision: week of Dec 20 (target Dec 22)

Ownership:
- Redwood: Marcus (sales) + Marissa (solutions/technical lead) + Neha (CS)
- ZenWell: James (product) + Priya (engineering)

Immediate asks:
1) Please review the success criteria and confirm or suggest edits by EOD Dec 2
2) Confirm availability of SSO/IT contact for the setup window (we need an owner for SAML work)
3) Share the list of expected exec attendees for the final readout (CPO/Head of AI recommended)

I'll circulate an updated POC plan once I hear back; attaching the initial checklist and success criteria.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Marcus — this looks good overall. Two quick notes: 

- We'd like to add a success criterion for hallucination rate on generated summaries (target < 5% on our sampled set).
- SSO is required for security sign-off; our identity team (Lauren Patel) will need to be looped for SAML access. She can do the SAML config during the prep window but needs the metadata and an expected maintenance window.

I'll confirm exec attendees once I check calendars — tentatively CPO (Anita Rao) + Head of AI (Ravi Shah).

James

- Added hallucination threshold (<5%) to evaluation metrics
- SSO/SAML prep scheduled Dec 3–7; Neha (cc'd) will coordinate the metadata exchange
- Marissa will lead the model & integration onboarding on Day 1 of the POC

Neha — can you own the SSO touchpoint and the weekly health check during the POC?

James/Priya — please confirm if Dec 8–19 still works with your team after SSO is scheduled.

Happy to own SSO and the day-to-day checks. Quick notes from the CS side and proposed evaluation plan: 

Evaluation plan (detailed):
1) Week 0 (prep): SAML metadata exchange, access provisioning, sample data ingestion test (sanitized), baseline metric capture
2) Week 1: Run intent classification tests, run generation tests on 10K examples, daily health checks with logs
3) Week 2: Load stability tests (48h), hallucination/precision evaluation against gold set, compile readout deck

Deliverables from Redwood: Daily health notes, a mid-POC checkpoint deck (Dec 14) and final readout deck (Dec 22).

Please send service account details and an internal email for the person who will provision SAML so I can follow up. Attached: zenwell_trial_checklist.pdf

James — propose we lock in the final readout for Wed, Dec 22 at 10:00 AM PT (duration 45 minutes). Recommended attendees: CPO (Anita Rao), Head of AI (Ravi Shah), Head of Integrations / IT (Lauren Patel), and a procurement attendee if possible.

Agenda (45m):
- 5m: Roll call & goals
- 10m: POC results summary (Neha & Marissa)
- 15m: Live demo + performance highlights (Marissa)
- 10m: Decision discussion (go / no-go) & procurement next steps (Marcus)
- 5m: Action items & close

Can you confirm:
1) If Anita & Ravi are available at that time
2) Whether procurement will need a redline window (our standard turnaround is 3–5 business days after receiving a redline)

I'll send a calendar invite (proposed_readout_invite.ics) once you confirm attendees. Also, we'll have our SOC2 snapshot available for procurement — attaching SOC2-snapshot.pdf here for your team to review ahead of time.

Thanks,
Marcus
